headline: Take Two Interactive Software (TTWO) Proposes Officer Liability Amendment For Shareholder Vote
summary: Take-Two Interactive Software (NasdaqGS:TTWO) has proposed an Officer Exculpation Amendment to its Restated Certificate of Incorporation. The amendment would limit the liability of certain officers to the fullest extent permitted under Delaware law. Shareholders are being asked to vote on the proposal after the Board recommended its approval. headline: Sony poised for 'GTA VI' boost as memory prices bite
summary: Sony is set to be a major beneficiary of the launch of "Grand Theft Auto VI" but the highly anticipated game is landing as the PlayStation maker grapples with rising prices of ‌memory chips.  The Japanese entertainment conglomerate, widely seen as the winner of the high-end console wars as Microsoft's Xbox business ‌retrenches, has a long history with Take-Two Interactive Software, which will launch its delayed "GTA VI" on November 19.  "GTA VI will be console only and the vast majority of ​new users will choose a PlayStation 5," said Serkan Toto, founder of Kantan Games consultancy.

headline: Should Take-Two’s Officer Liability Shield Proposal Reshape How TTWO Investors View Governance and Performance Risk?
summary: At its September 17, 2026 Annual Meeting, Take-Two Interactive Software proposed amending its Restated Certificate of Incorporation to limit certain officers’ liability in line with Delaware law, mainly shielding them from monetary damages in direct shareholder suits while retaining accountability for loyalty breaches and bad-faith or unlawful conduct.
